audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings credit Kayle's ranged form to her E — mid ('Her E ranged form'), whys[3] ('E ranged form plus her Q slow'), spikes[1].text ('her Q slow plus E ranged form'), wants.foe[0] ('switch to E ranged form') and wants.you[2] ('so her E kite ... can't keep her safe').
audit.why: The ranged form is Divine Ascent, her passive. The Wiki's Divine Ascent thresholds are Level 1 Zealous, Level 6 Arisen ('becomes ranged and gains 350 bonus attack range for a total of 525'), Level 11 Aflame, Level 16 Transcendent (625 range, permanent Zealous). Starfire Spellblade is a bonus-damage auto reset scaled to missing health and grants no range. This is not cosmetic: it tells the player the range is a toggled ability with a cooldown he could wait out, when in fact it is permanent from level 6 and the only thing to wait out is her ultimate.
audit.corrected: All five rewritten to Divine Ascent, with the 525 figure and the level-6 threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] credits the armour shred to 'E armor-shred'.
audit.why: The resistance reduction is Radiant Blast (Q) — 15% reduced armour AND magic resistance for 4 seconds on everything the sword pierces, at 900 range. Starfire Spellblade does no shredding. Getting this right matters because the shred lands from 900 range, i.e. from outside Wither, so the player is being softened before he can ever reach her.
audit.corrected: Attributed to Radiant Blast in breakdown.cooldowns, mid, whys[3], spikes[1] and both wants entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defect list: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. The entry says 'bait it' about Divine Judgment four times without ever saying what baiting it buys.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80. At rank 1 that is 160 seconds — the longest cooldown either champion has in the entire matchup. A Kayle who burns R at 6 is defenceless for two and a half minutes, which for a Nasus is roughly six waves of uncontested stacking or a free dive with the jungler. 'Bait it' with no number is unactionable; with the number it becomes the single biggest decision in the lane.
audit.corrected: 160s stated in breakdown.cooldowns, mid and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0] says 'Kayle wins every level-1 exchange' and sides levels 1-3 to Kayle. The content layer says the opposite: 'Kayle is melee with no ranged form before level 6, so the first three levels are mine to bully', and content win[] reads Nasus/Nasus/Skill.
audit.why: Kayle is melee until level 6 with no dash, no escape and the weakest early game of any top laner. Nasus loading Siphoning Strike on her face every time she walks up is the entire reason this matchup is winnable at 52.64%, and the full layer's chart tells the player to concede those exact levels. That is the most damaging single error in this entry, because it wastes the only window Nasus is ahead in.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [1] set to Nasus and phases[2] to Skill, with the why text for the first two rewritten to bully instructions. phases[4] set to Kayle and phases[5] to Kayle, matching content win[] — level 6 and her first item are hers, not skill and not Nasus.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4] calls level 6 'the first real fight you're allowed to take' and phases[5] says 'the lane bully phase is over; she knows it' as if first item were Nasus's spike.
audit.why: Level 6 is when she becomes ranged and gains Divine Judgment, and her first item is a Nashor's/Sheen spike that turns those ranged autos into real damage. Both stages are hers. The content layer says so; the full layer's stage text says the reverse.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line, despite _missing-interactions.json flagging needs-antiheal for this pairing, and Starfire Spellblade's missing-health scaling is never mentioned.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal plus move speed on herself and her nearest ally — in the two-item duel the entry tells the player to force, it is what lets her survive the one melee window he gets. And Starfire Spellblade deals bonus damage proportional to missing health, so it hits hardest at exactly the moment a Nasus who failed the burst is trying to walk away. Both belong in the late-game text.

dontsFull[1] 'Fight her level 16' checks out — Divine Ascent's Transcendent tier at 16 gives 625 total range and makes the Zealous bonuses permanent. Kept, and the description replaced with what actually happens at that level instead of boilerplate.

edits.before: This is where the scaling math finally tips back to me. By two-plus items my Siphoning Strike is fat enough that one empowered Q plus Fury of the Sands and Wither deletes her if I ever get on top of her — and her squishy frame can't survive that burst once I shut off her attack speed. The whole game is forcing that one melee window: flank her in fights, save Wither for the instant she steps into the open, and never let her free-cast ranged-form autos from max range. If she gets to kite me in a straight line with R up to deny the kill, she wins; if I land Wither and stick to her, she's dead before her DPS matters. Close fights fast and don't give her the long-range duel.

notes: The chart error here is worth flagging separately: full phases sided levels 1-3 to Kayle and said 'Kayle wins every level-1 exchange'. She is melee with no escape until 6 and those levels are the only ones Nasus is ahead in — a player following the full layer would concede the exact window the matchup is won in. The content layer had it right the whole time, so the two layers were giving opposite instructions for the first three levels. All five side labels happened to be five characters, so this one could be fully synced; the same class of mismatch in the Illaoi and Kassadin entries could not be, because 'Illaoi' and 'Kassadin' are not five characters long.
